# Implementation Plan: Teachers & Classes — UPDATE / DELETE Mutations

**Branch**: `006-teachers-classes-mutations` | **Date**: 2026-06-22 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/006-teachers-classes-mutations/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan is generated by the `/speckit-plan` command for the
Stage 3 mutation feature described in the spec. The plan inherits the
stack, container layout, and cross-cutting API contract from
[`001-teachers`](../001-teachers/plan.md) and
[`002-classes`](../002-classes/plan.md), and inherits the
authentication + hardening posture from
[`004-user-auth`](../004-user-auth/plan.md) and
[`005-security-hardening`](../005-security-hardening/plan.md). No
`NEEDS CLARIFICATION` remains in the spec (all six clarification
sub-sessions of 2026-06-22 are resolved); the Technical Context is
fully specified by inheritance.

## Summary

Ship the **Stage 3 mutation surface** for Teachers and Classes
authorised by Constitution v2.5.0 (Principle X — Domain Mutations &
Referential Integrity) and v2.6.0 (single-resource GET expansion).
Six new HTTP endpoints, all under the existing `/api/v1.0/` version
prefix (per `003-backend-api-db/spec.md` FR-022):

- `GET /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]` (NEW, v2.6.0) — single-resource
  read for the Edit Teacher page (per 006 spec FR-002).
- `GET /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]` (NEW, v2.6.0) — single-resource
  read for the Edit Class page (per 006 spec FR-003).
- `PUT /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]` — full-resource UPDATE on Teacher;
  re-runs subject-active, email-unique, and the restored Singapore
  `^[89]\d{7}$` contact-number rule; returns `200 OK` with the
  updated row in the same shape as a GET entry, plus a new
  `previousModifiedAt` field for the client-side concurrent-edit
  toast (per 006 spec FR-007 / FR-016).
- `PUT /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]` — full-resource UPDATE on Class;
  re-runs level-active, form-teacher-existence,
  form-teacher-uniqueness-against-different-class, and
  class-name-uniqueness (per 006 spec FR-008).
- `DELETE /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]` — hard delete; rejected with
  `409 Conflict` and the singular `details.classUlid` /
  `details.className` envelope when the teacher is currently a
  form teacher (per Principle X.1 + 006 spec FR-009); second
  DELETE returns `404 Not Found` per Principle X.2.
- `DELETE /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]` — hard delete; unconstrained at
  the database layer; second DELETE returns `404 Not Found`
  (per Principle X.2 + 006 spec FR-010).

The feature also ships the corresponding UI surface:

- A per-row `...` button on the Teachers list and the Classes
  list, opening an `antd` `Dropdown` with **Edit** and **Delete**
  items (per 006 spec FR-001).
- A **pre-populated Edit Teacher page** at
  `/teachers/[ulid]/edit` and a **pre-populated Edit Class page**
  at `/classes/[ulid]/edit` (per 006 spec FR-002 / FR-003) — both
  are React Server Components that call the new single-resource
  GET endpoints and pass the resolved record to the existing Add
  Teacher / Add Class form components in "edit mode" (gated by the
  presence of a path parameter). On `404` from the GET endpoint,
  the RSC shell calls `redirect("/teachers")` (or `redirect("/classes")`)
  with an antd warning notification.
- A **Delete confirmation modal** (`antd` `Modal.confirm`) embedding
  the row's `name` and the project's Tailwind destructive-action
  token on the **Delete** button (per 006 spec FR-004).
- A **concurrent-edit toast** — when a successful UPDATE returns
  `200 OK` with a `previousModifiedAt` that differs from the
  `modifiedAt` the form captured on mount, the list page renders
  a non-blocking antd warning notification reading
  `"Note: this record was edited by another administrator at HH:MM:SS — your changes are saved, but please verify."`
  (per 006 spec FR-016 / Clarifications Q3).

This feature **does not** introduce new entities, new tables, new
typeORM migrations, new runtime dependencies, or new design tokens.
It reuses the existing `Teacher` / `Class` entities and their audit
columns, the existing `lib/security/csrf-client.ts → getCsrfToken()`
helper introduced by `005-security-hardening`, the existing
authentication middleware from `004-user-auth`, the existing Add
Teacher / Add Class form components in "edit mode" (no new form
components), and the existing `FormField` / `Button` / `StateViews`
shared UI primitives. The Joi schemas for PUT mirror the POST
shape (full-resource replacement, every mutable field required);
the Joi schemas for DELETE are empty-body schemas that still run
the validation step (per Principle VII). The CSRF token is fetched
via `lib/security/csrf-client.ts → getCsrfToken()` on every
state-changing call (per Principle IX.3).

The plan inherits the stack, container layout, and cross-cutting API
contract from `001-teachers` and `002-classes`, and the
authentication + CSRF posture from `004-user-auth` and
`005-security-hardening`. This feature adds **zero** new runtime
dependencies and **zero** new devDependencies. The six new
endpoints are all exposed under the existing `/api/v1.0/` version
prefix per `003-backend-api-db/spec.md` FR-022.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript 5.x with `strict: true` (per
Constitution Principle II). No `.js` source files. The new route
handlers, Joi schemas, and React components are all `.ts`/`.tsx`;
the new unit / contract / integration tests are `.spec.ts` files
run by Vitest.

**Runtime**: Node.js LTS via the **same single Next.js 15
application** as `001-teachers`, `002-classes`, `004-user-auth`,
and `005-security-hardening`. The Constitution's "one process"
rule means the new routes, pages, and API endpoints all live
inside the existing `app/` tree; no new process, no new
container runtime, no new application. The RSC pages
(`app/(authed)/teachers/[ulid]/edit/page.tsx`,
`app/(authed)/classes/[ulid]/edit/page.tsx`) join the existing
`(authed)` route group introduced by `004-user-auth` for
session-protected pages.

**Primary Dependencies**: same as `001-teachers` (see
[research.md §6.1](./research.md#61-stack-inheritance-from-001002004005)),
**plus zero new runtime dependencies** and **zero new
devDependencies** for this feature. The locked stack is:

- `next@^15` (framework, App Router, RSC)
- `react@^19` and `react-dom@^19`
- `typeorm@^0.3` + `mysql2@^3` (data access; entity classes are the
  only allowed class-based code)
- `joi@^17` (request validation, Principle VII)
- `antd@<pinned>` (UI primitives, per Constitution v2.3.0)
- `tailwindcss@<pinned>`, `postcss@<pinned>`,
  `autoprefixer@<pinned>` (styling, per Constitution v2.3.0)
- `dotenv@^16` (runtime configuration loader)
- `ulid@<pinned>` (cross-cutting `ulid` row-handle column, per
  `003-backend-api-db/spec.md` FR-021)
- `argon2@^0.40.x`, `ioredis@^5.4.x` (auth + session store,
  inherited from `004-user-auth`)
- `ioredis-mock@^8.9.x` (unit-test stub for `ioredis`)
- `vitest` (test runner, inherited from `001-teachers`)

**Storage**: same MySQL 8 container (user-prepared, per FR-016
cross-cutting rule) and same Redis 7 container (introduced by
`004-user-auth`) as Stages 1 + 2. This feature **adds no new
tables** and **runs no new migrations**. The mutation surface
operates on the existing `teachers`, `classes`, `subjects`, and
`levels` tables from `001-teachers` / `002-classes`. The
`UNIQUE INDEX uq_classes_form_teacher_id` constraint on
`classes.form_teacher_id` is the data-layer backstop for the
Principle X.1 form-teacher referential integrity check on
DELETE-Teacher (the check is also done explicitly in the route
handler so the 409 envelope is human-readable rather than a raw
typeORM unique-constraint error). The `UNIQUE` index on
`teachers.email` is the backstop for the email-uniqueness
invariant on POST + PUT.

**Testing**: Vitest (inherited from `001-teachers`). Three test
tiers per [research.md §6.4](./research.md#64-test-strategy-vitest-three-tiers):

| Tier | Path | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| **Unit** | `tests/unit/teachers/mutations.spec.ts`, `tests/unit/classes/mutations.spec.ts` | `lib/validation/teacher.ts` (PUT + DELETE Joi), `lib/validation/class.ts` (PUT + DELETE Joi), `lib/api/teachers/repository.ts` (findByUlid, update, delete, with form-teacher guard), `lib/api/classes/repository.ts` (findByUlid, update, delete), `lib/security/csrf-client.ts` (existing helper). Pure functions, no DB, no network, no auth. |
| **Contract** | `tests/contract/teachers-mutations.api.spec.ts`, `tests/contract/classes-mutations.api.spec.ts` | Full GET / PUT / DELETE lifecycle against a test Next.js server with `ioredis-mock` + an in-memory MySQL stub. Verifies the 200 / 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 415 status matrix per `003-backend-api-db/spec.md` FR-013 (the Stage 3 amendment). |
| **Integration** | `tests/integration/teachers-mutations.api.spec.ts`, `tests/integration/classes-mutations.api.spec.ts` | Real MySQL + real Redis containers; `SC-001`..`SC-008` end-to-end. The DELETE-Teacher 409 path is tested with a real `classes` row pointing at the teacher under test; the form-teacher collision on PUT-Class is tested with two pre-seeded classes sharing the same form teacher. |

**Project Type**: same as `001-teachers`, `002-classes`,
`004-user-auth`, and `005-security-hardening` — single Next.js
web application. The 006 feature adds:

- **6 new route handlers** under `app/api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]/`
  and `app/api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]/` (GET, PUT, DELETE for each).
- **2 new RSC pages** at `app/(authed)/teachers/[ulid]/edit/page.tsx`

- **1 new client component** at

- **1 new shared hook** at
  `lib/hooks/use-edit-submit.ts` — wraps the PUT + concurrent-edit

- **2 new repository methods** on the existing typeORM
  repositories — `findByUlid` (shared by GET / Edit page /
  POST + PUT validation lookups), and the DELETE guard
  (`findClassByFormTeacherId` returning 0 or 1 rows against
  `uq_classes_form_teacher_id`).
- **4 new Joi schemas** (PUT-teacher, DELETE-teacher empty body,
  PUT-class, DELETE-class empty body) under `lib/validation/`.
- **3 new test files** (contract, integration per surface — 4
  total: 2 contract + 2 integration) under `tests/contract/` and
  `tests/integration/`. Unit tests are added to the existing
  `lib/validation/*.spec.ts` files (per the spec's Assumption
  "Stage 3 unit tests reuse the existing per-feature test
  fixtures").

No new project, no new process, no new container runtime, no
new application.

**Performance Goals**:

- The PUT handler adds **one MySQL `SELECT`** (the path-`ulid`
  row resolution against `uq_teachers_ulid` / `uq_classes_ulid`)
  + **one MySQL `UPDATE`** (the row write) + **one MySQL
  `SELECT`** (the active-`subjects` / active-`levels`
  validation against `uq_subjects_ulid` / `uq_levels_ulid`).
  Total PUT latency: ~5–15 ms p95 on a local MySQL.
- The DELETE handler adds **one MySQL `SELECT`** (the
  form-teacher guard, an indexed lookup against
  `uq_classes_form_teacher_id` — `O(log n)` on the classes
  table; returns 0 or 1 rows) + **one MySQL `DELETE`** (the
  row removal) on the success path. The DELETE-Teacher 409
  path skips the DELETE and returns after the SELECT.
- The new GET single-resource handler adds **one MySQL
  `SELECT`** + **one MySQL `JOIN`** (the
  `subject` / `level` / `formTeacher` reference resolution).
  Total GET-by-`ulid` latency: ~3–10 ms p95 on a local MySQL.
- The end-to-end form-time budgets from `SC-001` (Edit Teacher
  ≤ 30 s) and `SC-002` (Delete Teacher ≤ 5 s) remain the only
  user-perceived latency targets. No new API-level latency
  target is added in Stage 3.

**Constraints**:

- All `001-teachers`, `002-classes`, `004-user-auth`, and
  `005-security-hardening` constraints apply (TS strict, no
  class-based code outside typeORM entities, Joi mirroring,
  session-based auth, CSRF, CORS, CSP, XSS posture).
- The cross-cutting contract is **non-negotiable**: every new
  route handler goes through `withApiContract` (Stage 1 wrapper)
  + `withAuth` (Stage 2 wrapper) + `withCsrf` (Stage 2 wrapper
  for state-changing methods; GET is exempt per Principle IX.3);
  every error response uses `{ "error": "..." }` with the
  optional `details` extension on DELETE-Teacher 409; every
  status code is in the cross-cutting table; every endpoint
  uses the `/api/v1.0/` version prefix.
- The PUT handlers are **full-resource replacement** (Stage 3
  ships full-resource `PUT` only — no `PATCH`; see Stage 3
  Out of Scope). Every mutable field is required on every
  PUT call.
- The DELETE handlers return **`200 OK` with `{ "ulid": "..." }`**
  on success (NOT `204 No Content`, per
  `TODO(STAGE3_DELETE_RESPONSE_SHAPE)` in the constitution Sync
  Impact Report — envelope consistency with the rest of the
  API). A second DELETE on the same `ulid` returns
  `404 Not Found` with `{ "error": "Teacher not found" }` or
  `{ "error": "Class not found" }` (idempotent per
  Principle X.2).
- The DELETE-Teacher 409 envelope is the **singular object**
  shape per Clarifications Session 2026-06-22 (DELETE-Teacher
  409 envelope — one-to-one simplification):
  `{ "error": "Teacher is assigned as form teacher of class \"<className>\". Reassign or delete that class first.", "details": { "classUlid": "<classUlid>", "className": "<className>" } }`.
  The previous array envelope (`classUlids[]` / `classNames[]`)
  and the N > 5 truncation logic are superseded.
- The form-teacher referential integrity check on DELETE-Teacher
  is implemented as a **single indexed query**:
  `SELECT id, ulid, name FROM classes WHERE form_teacher_id = ?`
  (the `UNIQUE` index on `classes.form_teacher_id` is the
  index; the query is `O(log n)` against the index; the
  constraint guarantees at most one row is returned). No
  full-table scan, no `LEFT JOIN`. The returned row's `ulid`
  and `name` are used as `details.classUlid` and the embedded
  class name in the `error` string per FR-009.
- The Singapore contact-number rule
  (`^[89]\d{7}$` — exactly 8 digits, must start with `8` or
  `9`) applies on **both** POST (Add Teacher) and PUT (Edit
  Teacher) per Clarifications Session 2026-06-22 (contact-
  number rule restoration). The Joi schema regex is the single
  source of truth; the unit tests cover the leading-digit
  rejection path (values starting with `0`–`7` and `10`–`99`
  are rejected with `400 Bad Request`).
- The Edit form's CSRF token is fetched via the existing
  `lib/security/csrf-client.ts → getCsrfToken()` helper
  (introduced by `005-security-hardening`); both `PUT` and
  `DELETE` send the `X-CSRF-Token` header. `GET` requests are
  CSRF-exempt per Principle IX.3.
- The `details` extension on the error envelope is additive —
  existing clients that only read the `error` field are
  unaffected. The contract is forward-compatible: future
  Stage 3 endpoints MAY add a `details` block to their error
  envelopes.
- **Keyboard accessibility** for the per-row `...` menu and
  the Delete confirmation modal is **NOT** a Stage 3
  requirement per Clarifications Session 2026-06-22 Q4 (in
  the `/speckit-clarify` pass). The mouse-only posture is
  intentional and is not a defect. The `aria-label="Row actions"`
  on the menu trigger is preserved as a low-cost screen-reader
  hint that is announced on mouse hover/focus regardless of
  keyboard-interaction support.

**Scale/Scope**:

- 1 application process (Next.js, same as Stages 1 + 2) +
  1 database process (MySQL, same as Stages 1 + 2) +
  1 session-store process (Redis, introduced by Stage 2).
- 5 DB tables in the schema (unchanged from Stage 1 + Stage 2):
  `subjects` + `teachers` + `levels` + `classes` + `users`. All
  five carry the cross-cutting `ulid CHAR(26) UNIQUE` column
  (per FR-021, owned by `003-backend-api-db`).
- **6 new API endpoints** (per 006 spec / Constitution v2.5.0
  + v2.6.0):
  - `GET /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]` (v2.6.0 NEW)
  - `GET /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]` (v2.6.0 NEW)
  - `PUT /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]`
  - `PUT /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]`
  - `DELETE /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]`
  - `DELETE /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]`
- 2 new RSC pages (`/teachers/[ulid]/edit`,
  `/classes/[ulid]/edit`).
- 0 new tables, 0 new entities, 0 new typeORM migrations, 0 new
  runtime dependencies, 0 new devDependencies, 0 new design
  tokens, 0 new form components, 0 new auth controls, 0 new
  hardening controls.
- 0 background jobs, 0 cron tasks, 0 worker processes.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Principle | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| I. Spec-Driven Development | ✅ Pass | Plan is generated by `/speckit-plan` after `/speckit-specify` + 6 clarification sub-sessions (the 2026-06-22 base session, the contact-number restoration session, the `/speckit-clarify` Q1–Q5 pass, the Q2 re-answer per constitution v2.6.0, and the DELETE-Teacher 409 envelope one-to-one simplification). Tasks will be generated by `/speckit-tasks`; no source code is written before this plan is approved. |
| II. TypeScript End-to-End (`strict: true`) | ✅ Pass | Same single `tsconfig.json` as `001-teachers` / `002-classes` / `004-user-auth` / `005-security-hardening` covers the whole app; the new route handlers, the new RSC pages, the new Joi schemas, the new typeORM repository methods, and the new tests are all `.ts`/`.tsx`; no `.js` source files. |
| III. Unit Tests Required | ✅ Pass | Same Vitest setup. The new Joi schemas (PUT-teacher, DELETE-teacher empty body, PUT-class, DELETE-class empty body) get unit tests (happy + each rejection path, including the leading-digit contact-number rejection and the same-form-teacher-on-same-class allowance). The new repository methods (`findByUlid`, the form-teacher guard `findClassByFormTeacherId`) get repository tests. The new contract and integration tests cover the full GET / PUT / DELETE lifecycle including the 200 / 400 / 401 / 403 / 404 / 409 / 415 / 500 / 503 status matrix. |
| IV. Single Role: Administrator | ✅ Pass | The new endpoints are protected by the existing `withAuth` middleware from `004-user-auth`. No new roles, no new authorization matrix. The session cookie carries `HttpOnly` + `Secure` (env-driven) + `SameSite=Strict` per Principle IV. The `withAuth` middleware rejects with `401 Unauthorized` when no valid session cookie is presented; this is true for every new Stage 3 endpoint. |
| V. Simplicity (YAGNI) | ✅ Pass | No abstractions ahead of the spec. No DTOs, no class-based service layers, no DI container, no new design tokens, no new form components, no new auth controls, no new hardening controls, no new dependencies, no new tables. The Edit forms reuse the existing Add Teacher / Add Class form components in "edit mode" (gated by the presence of a path parameter); the Row Actions Menu is a thin wrapper around `antd` `Dropdown` reused by both Teachers and Classes lists. The smallest possible extension to the existing codebase that satisfies the spec. |
| VI. Functional-First (Classes Only When Necessary) | ✅ Pass | Same rule as `001-teachers` / `002-classes`: the new route handlers are small modules of pure functions; the new RSC pages are React Server Components (function components); the new client component (`RowActionsMenu`) is a function component with hooks; the new shared hook (`use-edit-submit`) is a pure-function composition of `fetch` + `notification` + `router.push`. The only new classes are the typeORM entity classes (`Teacher`, `Class`) which already exist; no new entity classes are introduced. |
| VII. Joi Schema Validation | ✅ Pass | Every new endpoint validates its request body with Joi before any typeORM call. The Joi schema for `PUT-teacher` mirrors the `POST-teacher` shape (full-resource replacement: `name`, `subject` as nested `{ ulid, name }`, `email`, `contactNumber`); the Joi schema for `PUT-class` mirrors the `POST-class` shape (full-resource replacement: `name`, `level` as nested `{ ulid, name }`, `formTeacher` as nested `{ ulid, name }`); the Joi schemas for `DELETE` are empty-body schemas that still run the validation step (per Principle VII). The Singapore `^[89]\d{7}$` regex is restored on `Teacher.contactNumber` (per Clarifications Session 2026-06-22 contact-number rule restoration). The form-teacher uniqueness check on `PUT-class` excludes the row being updated (a class updating to the same form teacher it already has is permitted; a class updating to a form teacher belonging to a different class is rejected with `409 Conflict`); the email-uniqueness check on `PUT-teacher` excludes the row being updated (submitting the teacher's current email as the new email is a valid no-op that returns `200 OK`). |
| VIII. UI Quality — Self-Explanatory, Reusable, Simple | ✅ Pass | The new components (`RowActionsMenu`, `use-edit-submit` hook, Edit pages) are function components / hooks with explicit typed props. The shared `FormField` / `Button` / `StateViews` / Add Teacher form / Add Class form are reused — no feature-specific hard-coding. The Row Actions Menu is composed from `antd` `Dropdown` primitives and styled with `tailwindcss` utility classes (per Constitution v2.3.0); it is reused by both the Teachers list and the Classes list. The Delete confirmation uses the existing `antd` `Modal.confirm` function-call API (no new modal component). The destructive `Delete` button uses the project's existing Tailwind destructive-action token (per 006 spec Clarifications Q2 and FR-004); no new design tokens. The `ulid` field (per FR-021) is displayed as a monospace string in any UI surface that needs the row handle (e.g., the row key for the `antd` `Table`). |
| IX. Security & Hardening (NON-NEGOTIABLE) | ✅ Pass (inherited) | **CORS**: the `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` allow-list, the `Access-Control-Allow-Methods` allow-list, the `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` flag, and the preflight `OPTIONS` handler are owned by `005-security-hardening/middleware.ts` and apply to every new Stage 3 endpoint without modification. **CSP**: the restrictive `Content-Security-Policy` header is owned by `005-security-hardening/next.config.mjs` and applies to every response from the Next.js application (including the new RSC pages and the new API responses) without modification. **CSRF**: the double-submit-cookie middleware is owned by `005-security-hardening/middleware.ts`; `PUT` and `DELETE` on `/api/v1.0/*` MUST send the `X-CSRF-Token` header matching the `csrfToken` cookie (constant-time comparison); `GET` is exempt per Principle IX.3. The Stage 3 unit / contract / integration tests verify the 403 path for missing / mismatched `X-CSRF-Token` on PUT and DELETE. **XSS**: input validation (Joi), output encoding (React's default + JSON-stringify), and CSP (defense-in-depth) are inherited from Stages 1 + 2. The application does NOT use `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `eval`, or any other string-to-code sink. |
| X. Domain Mutations & Referential Integrity (NON-NEGOTIABLE) | ✅ Pass (owning) | **X.1**: `DELETE /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]` runs the form-teacher referential integrity check (`SELECT id, ulid, name FROM classes WHERE form_teacher_id = ?`) before the row removal; the route returns `409 Conflict` with the singular `details.classUlid` / `details.className` envelope per 006 spec FR-009. The `UNIQUE INDEX uq_classes_form_teacher_id` is the data-layer backstop. **X.2**: `DELETE /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]` is unconstrained at the database layer; the route returns `200 OK` with `{ "ulid": "..." }` on success and `404 Not Found` with `{ "error": "Class not found" }` on a second DELETE on the same `ulid` (idempotent per Principle X.2). `DELETE-teacher` has the same `200` / `404` envelope. **X.3**: `PUT /api/v1.0/teachers/[ulid]` re-runs subject-active (FR-005a, 001-teachers), email-unique (FR-005, 001-teachers, with the row-exclusion self-match rule), and the restored Singapore `^[89]\d{7}$` contact-number rule (006 spec FR-013). `PUT /api/v1.0/classes/[ulid]` re-runs level-active (FR-005a, 002-classes), form-teacher-existence (FR-004, 002-classes), form-teacher-uniqueness against a different class (FR-005, 002-classes, with the same-class self-match rule), and class-name-uniqueness (FR-005c, 002-classes). The `200` response body on PUT additionally carries the pre-update `modified_at` value as `previousModifiedAt` (per 006 spec FR-007 / FR-016) for the client-side concurrent-edit toast. The unit tests cover all three negative paths for each resource (a) DELETE-Teacher blocked when the teacher is a current form teacher, (b) DELETE idempotency (second DELETE returns 404), (c) UPDATE re-running every POST-side invariant. |

**Structure Decision**: Web application — Option 2 from the plan
template, collapsed to a single Next.js codebase (not a separate
backend repo) per the Constitution's "one process" rule. The
006 feature reuses the existing `(authed)` route group for the
two new RSC pages (per `004-user-auth`) and the existing
`withApiContract` + `withAuth` + `withCsrf` middleware chain
(per Stages 1 + 2). No new project, no new container, no new
process is introduced.

## Complexity Tracking

> **Fill ONLY if Constitution Check has violations that must be justified**

No violations. No entries required.

The pre-existing locked stack (TypeScript strict, Next.js 15
App Router, MySQL 8, typeORM 0.3, Joi 17, antd, Tailwind CSS,
Redis 7, Vitest, Docker Compose) covers the entire Stage 3
surface without modification. The Singapore `^[89]\d{7}$`
contact-number rule is restored as a one-line Joi regex change
in `lib/validation/contact-number.ts` (a new shared module
re-exported by both `001-teachers/lib/validation/teacher.ts`
and `006-teachers-classes-mutations/lib/validation/teacher.ts`).
The form-teacher referential integrity check is implemented as
a single indexed query against `classes.form_teacher_id`'s
`UNIQUE` index. The DELETE-Teacher 409 envelope is the
singular object shape per Clarifications Session 2026-06-22
(DELETE-Teacher 409 envelope — one-to-one simplification).
The `previousModifiedAt` field is a single line in the
repository's `findByUlidAndReturnPreviousModifiedAt` helper.
No new dependencies, no new design tokens, no new
abstractions.
